title: 第23章 周武年轻第一人第24章 让你一手一脚敢签生死状吗
content_zh:
“我承认你非常优秀，能吸引很多女人喜欢，但我保证，你绝对得不到韵姐。”严冰严肃道。
韵姐跟丈夫分开十年，如果她是一个随便的女人，早就被人追到手了。
“谁说我要得到她了？”
“你看她眼神都放光了。”
“我看你的眼神，更闪亮。”
张扬上前两步，右手托起她下巴，细细端详着。
这张脸真是很耐看，越看越独特，开发价值很高。
哪个男人不想，把一个清纯美女从小玩到大啊！
严冰一把打掉他的手，生气道：“我跟韵姐都不是随便的人，拿开你的脏手。”
张扬没有生气，反而笑了起来。
“优秀的男人，可能没时间一直陪着女人，但是他每陪女人一天，女人都会非常快乐。有些男人天天陪在女人身边，女人却只感到厌烦。选择短暂快乐，还是选择碌碌无为的麻木，就看你自己了。”
张扬突然贴脸，严冰吓了一跳，就在她准备反抗的时候，张扬已经离开，手里多了一张房卡。
“房卡由我暂时保管，你不介意吧？”张扬问。
严冰愤怒地瞪了他一眼，转身离开。
张扬鬼魅一笑，严冰没问他要回房卡，说明他的洗脑成功了一半。
今夜她没反锁房门，那么就成功了九成半。
晚上十一点，张扬悄悄溜出房间，拿房卡滴开严冰的房间。
正准备推开，房间被卡住了。
很遗憾，严冰没给他留门。
严冰跟了何诗韵这么久，耳濡目染，性格肯定也很传统。

张扬并不觉得遗憾，反而觉得很有趣，他很好奇，严冰跟何诗韵，自己会先拿下谁？
……
第二天一早。
张扬在房间修炼了半个小时，八点钟到西餐厅吃自助早餐。
好巧不巧，何诗韵跟严冰也在，两女刚坐下不久。
张扬在两女旁边坐下，打了个招呼。
两女点了点头，算是回应。
张扬跟何诗韵没话说，经过昨晚的事情之后，跟严冰也没说话了。
三人明明坐在一起，却像是最熟悉的陌生人。
“韵姐，养生图什么来历，值三百万起拍价？”
作为男人，应该主动一点，张扬开口询问。
“那是真迹，当然贵了，我听说，真迹中蕴含着一个大秘密。”
张扬主动说话，何诗韵也不好再寒着脸。
关系搞得这样僵，她也有责任，若不是她主动给机会，张扬也无法趁虚而入。
两人只是价值观不同，又没有仇。
“等拍下来，给我记得给我观摩一下。”
“看一看五万块。”
“卧槽，摸一摸就收五万，镶金的都没这么贵。”
张扬说话时，故意将摸一摸三个字加重，何诗韵听完，在桌下踢了他一下。
有感觉的男女之间，就是这么奇妙，有时候一个眼神，一个小动作，就能让恨烟消云散。

也有可能一个眼神，一个小动作，就让对方脾气暴涨。
不能用常理来形容。
反正张扬就是感觉，何诗韵的气一下子就消了不少。
“不想看别看，没人强迫你。”何诗韵冷哼。
“韵姐，别说五万，五十万看一下都值了。”张扬笑道。
content_en:
"I admit that you are very good and can attract many women, but I guarantee that you will never get Sister Yun." Yan Bing said seriously.
Sister Yun has been separated from her husband for ten years. If she were a casual woman, she would have been chased by someone long ago.
"Who said I was going to get her?"
"Look at her eyes lighting up."
"The way I look at you is even brighter."
Zhang Yang took two steps forward, held up her chin with his right hand, and looked at her carefully.
This face is really attractive. The more you look at it, the more unique it becomes, and its development value is very high.
What man wouldn’t want to play with a pure and beautiful girl from childhood to adulthood?
Yan Bing knocked his hand off and said angrily: "Sister Yun and I are not casual people, please take your dirty hands away."
Zhang Yang was not angry, but laughed.
"An excellent man may not have time to accompany a woman all the time, but every time he spends a day with a woman, the woman will be very happy. Some men stay with a woman every day, but the woman only feels bored. It depends on you to choose short-term happiness or the numbness of inaction."
Yan Bing was startled when Zhang Yang suddenly kissed her face. Just when she was about to resist, Zhang Yang had already left with a room card in her hand.
"I will keep the room card temporarily, do you mind?" Zhang Yang asked.
Yan Bing glared at him angrily, turned and left.
Zhang Yang smiled ghostly, and Yan Bing didn't ask him for his room card, which meant that his brainwashing was half successful.
She didn't lock the door tonight, so she was 95% successful.
At eleven o'clock in the evening, Zhang Yang quietly slipped out of the room, took the room card and opened Yan Bing's room.
Just as he was about to push it away, the room was stuck.
Unfortunately, Yan Bing didn't leave the door open for him.
Yan Bing has been following He Shiyun for so long, and he must be very traditional in character.
Zhang Yang didn't feel regretful, but found it very interesting. He was very curious, who would he win first, Yan Bing or He Shiyun?
…
Early the next morning.
Zhang Yang practiced in his room for half an hour and went to the Western restaurant for breakfast buffet at eight o'clock.
By coincidence, He Shiyun and Yan Bing were also there, not long after the two women sat down.
Zhang Yang sat down next to the two women and said hello.
The two women nodded in response.
Zhang Yang had nothing to say to He Shiyun, and after what happened last night, he had nothing to say to Yan Bing either.
The three of them were obviously sitting together, but they seemed like the most familiar strangers.
"Sister Yun, what is the origin of the health chart, and is it worth the starting price of three million?"
As a man, you should take the initiative and ask openly.
"That's an authentic work. Of course it's expensive. I heard that the original work contains a big secret."
Zhang Yang took the initiative to speak, and He Shiyun couldn't help but feel cold anymore.
She was also responsible for the relationship being so tense. If she hadn't taken the initiative to give him the opportunity, Zhang Yang wouldn't have been able to take advantage of it.
The two people just have different values, but there is no hatred.
"When it's filmed, remember to give it a look."
"Look at fifty thousand dollars."
"Damn it, it's fifty thousand for just touching it, even the gold-encrusted ones are not that expensive."
When Zhang Yang was speaking, he deliberately emphasized the word "touch". After hearing this, He Shiyun kicked him under the table.
It's so wonderful between men and women who have feelings. Sometimes a look or a small movement can make hatred disappear.
It's also possible that a look or a small action can make the other person's temper flare up.
It cannot be described by common sense.
Anyway, Zhang Yang was just a feeling, and He Shiyun's anger suddenly dissipated a lot.
"Don't watch it if you don't want to, no one forces you." He Shiyun snorted coldly.
"Sister Yun, let alone fifty thousand, half a million is worth it just by looking at it." Zhang Yang said with a smile.
